notes:
1. Section 1 says "Those are the kinds of jobs a bank's operations team runs all day". Source (The Decoder): "built for high-volume tasks like data queries and customer support." No source says what a bank's operations team runs, and the brief calls it only a high-volume model. Fix: delete the sentence's claim about banks, e.g. "Those are high-volume jobs, and the price list is worth reading line by line."
2. Section 1 also leaves out a caveat in the same source: "Haiku 5.5 uses an updated tokenizer that consumes slightly more tokens per task than its predecessor ... Real-world savings are likely smaller than the per-token prices suggest." Fix: add that the savings per task may be smaller than the per-token cut (cite that sentence in support), or say "per-token prices" instead of "costs about 75 percent less".
3. Title says "Cheaper models and agent wallets change the back office". No section shows a change to bank back offices; the GPT-6 section is customer-facing and the wallet section is a company's plan and product. Fix: a title that says only what the sections say, e.g. "Cheaper small models, chat tools and agent wallets arrive".
4. Section 3 says "SPAC (a listed shell company)". Source: "a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) merger". "Listed shell company" is not in the source. Fix: "SPAC (special purpose acquisition company)".
